On click the listener makes the captured Frame visible and sets Frame state to 0 (NORMAL), restoring/unminimizing the launcher window from the system tray.

For the exact special display/platform state, when the frame is not focused it briefly hides the frame and invokes the existing refresh helper before showing/restoring it, confirming this listener owns tray-triggered window restoration.
